title: Three people killed in car crash on Tehran's Hemmat Highway
text:
"Three people killed in car crash on Tehran's Hemmat Highway"

"According to the Tehran Fire Department spokesperson, a BMW crashed into the central guardrails of the Hemmat Highway early this morning while traveling east to west."

"In the incident, two women and one man lost their lives, while a fourth person was injured and taken to the hospital. The cause of the accident is still unknown.
